Identify discrete metadata columns in a dittoSeq object

Source: R/ditto_helpers.R
INTERNAL_ditto_discrete_metas.Rd

Metadata are treated as discrete when they are logicals, numeric columns with a small number of unique values (<= max.levels), or factors and characters with fewer than max.categories levels. A character column of cell barcodes is left out, since it would ask for one colour per cell.

Usage

.ditto_discrete_metas(object, max.levels = 30, max.categories = 50)

Arguments

object

A dittoSeq-compatible object.

max.levels

Maximum number of unique values for a numeric column to be treated as discrete.

max.categories

Factor and character columns with this many or more levels are left out. Passed to VizModules::facet_check().

Value

A character vector of discrete metadata names.
